Container.Name: My-Cloud
Container.Overview: My Cloud is a lightweight file sharing platform in the spirit of Nextcloud/ownCloud, but with zero database setup. Multi-user accounts, a fast web file browser with previews, drag-and-drop uploads, public share links with passwords and expiry, a trash bin, and quotas - all stored as simple JSON files. Perfect for home users who don't have a ton of files and don't want to babysit a database.
Container.Description: Lightweight, database-free file sharing platform. On first launch, open the WebUI to create your admin account. User files are stored under the Data path at users/<username>/files, so they stay plain files on your array - browsable from any Unraid share tool.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: App settings, users and share links (small JSON files)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns created files (Unraid default: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns created files (Unraid default: 100 = users)
